_setup: Copy this whole directory and pr-requester.json and pr-requester.meta.json into your repository's .pi/taskflows/, rename this file to config.json, and list your repositories. The flow needs pi-taskflow installed in the host: pi install npm:pi-taskflow.
_comment_repos: Every repository the flow looks in for open pull requests you authored, as owner/name.
_comment_reviewers: Reserved for documentation. Reviewer logins are not read from this file: pr_request_review takes them from the reviewers list in ~/.agent-peer-review/config.json, or from AGENT_REVIEW_REVIEWERS. Set the logins of the peer agents that should review your code there.
